decision.reason: Neither Tradier sandbox nor Alpaca paper satisfies the unchanged complete-accounting contract; Interactive Brokers is only an unimplemented candidate.

contract: Restart reconciliation without treating missing history as empty

venues.documented_capability: Balances, positions, current orders, and order details; account history is documented as unavailable for sandbox accounts.
blockers: Current-session order list is not complete historical activity
Complete costs and precise immutable timeline cannot be proven
Restart and missed-session recovery cannot be demonstrated

venues.documented_capability: Historical account activities with stable IDs and ID-based page_token pagination; FILL transaction_time and order_id; non-fill date fields.
blockers: Observed account had no fills, so commission and fill linkage were not proven
Documented paper simulation omits regulatory fees, dividends, and borrow fees
Non-fill date fields do not satisfy precise activity time
Restart and delayed-activity recovery remain untested

venues.documented_capability: Trade history documents UTC trade_time and commission; TWS commission reports document execution commission fields.
blockers: No project adapter or paper-account evidence
Web API trade history is limited to seven days
Complete non-trade cash activity and delayed-event coverage are unproven
Restart reconciliation design and tests do not exist

required_next_decisions: Keep the launch blocked and preserve Tradier production market-data isolation.
If Alpaca is reconsidered, obtain separate permission for a credentialed read-only evidence operation using the corrected adapter; no test orders are authorized.
If Interactive Brokers is selected, approve a new paper-provider boundary and a durable activity-capture design before implementation.
Do not relax unknown-cost handling or treat modeled costs as broker evidence without a separately approved contract.
